profile.headline: Director, Software Engineering at GLG
profile.summary: Technology leader with over two decades of experience in architecting, designing, and developing scalable software solutions, ranging from micro-services and cloud-based platforms to high-volume transactional systems and enterprise-grade customer engagement platforms. Currently leading the development of mission-critical systems that drive substantial business revenue, ensuring reliability, performance, and strategic alignment with organizational goals. Passionate about mentoring teams, optimizing technical architectures, and delivering impactful solutions that solve complex challenges.

positions.title: Director Software Engineering
positions.description:
• Leadership of high-performing team responsible for mission-critical revenue-driving communication system
• Led the migration of real-time data streaming architecture from Azure EventGrid to AWS EventBridge, optimizing performance and scalability for high-value client interactions
• Define technical vision, mentor engineers, and collaborate with cross-functional leaders to align technology with business goals, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Drive architecture, scalability, and reliability of GLG’s conference platform, facilitating high-value client interactions
• Designed and implemented real-time data streaming enhancements, improving platform performance using Azure EventGrid and WebRTC-based solutions
• Collaborate cross-functionally to optimize technical strategy, infrastructure, and product roadmaps

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Facilitated development of various full-stack solutions which utilized the Amazon AWS CDK
• Deployed EventBridge and Lambda functions for backend business processes through event-based workflows
• These processes supported the VueJS based front end built on NuxtJS

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: • Developed real-time data streams to efficiently transmit event-driven data across the Event Bus, delivering insights via a real-time WebSocket-powered support dashboard

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for the key revenue stream of the organization, the consultation scheduling system
• This system utilized a VueJS frontend built on Gridsome to deliver a custom WebRTC implementation which facilitated consultation calls on our conference system

positions.title: Application Engineer II
positions.description:
Front end JavaScript development with advanced enhancements to a mature VueJS product personalization platform which include:
Personalization persistence, enhanced image manipulation techniques, and improved client side renderings for various engraved products. 

General improvements to our backend build processes including a custom proxy to facilitate quick prototyping of our client side applications within our web platforms. 

Performed base migration to Webpack from Gulp. 

Helped develop the integration with our shopping cart SPA with our payment gateway.

Facilitated various improvements to PCI compliant payment gateway. 

Enhanced the core composition and template  system  used by our new personalized promotional product line

Continued enhancements and improvements, including Square Register integration within the iPad order fulfillment app

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Recipient of the 2012 Harland Clarke Pillar of Excellence for Customer Focus, awarded to the top 3% of employees within the organization.

Helped develop a enterprise level iOS App for the iPad which is used for in person order processing at live events.

Redesigned our enterprise payment gateway to facilitate credit card processing, complete with a new UI and various other performance and security improvements.

Continued development and support of various RESTful services and web service solutions used in fulfillment of our company's products.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Support duties surrounding an Adobe InDesign based web to print solution powered by XMPie uProduce. 

Handled numerous support related activities for the various ecommerce websites Harland Clarke Retail Channels operates. 

Supported various web services in support of the different ecommerce websites operated by Harland Clarke Retail Channels. 

Developed a customer claim management system used for tracking customer claims from a product offering of the organization. 

Designed various Photoshop and InDesign scripts which the graphic artist teams use for asset creation.

Coordinated the development and handled improvements of a custom Flash based InDesign plugin which facilitates product asset creation for a web to print solution. 

Coordinated the development and handled improvements of a C# and ExtemdScript based composition service for a web to print solution. 

Designed and developed various REST services and web portals which assist in the management of products and composition requests for a web to print solution.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Facilitated several major client specific data mining operations. 

Handled primary support duties for a variable web to print platform designed around Adobe InDesign server and XMPie uProduce.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
Facilitated and led all technical support for all 5 companies and all self storage facilities across the United States. 

Responsible for all technology related decisions, ranging from hardware recommendations and purchases to the design and implementation of a nationwide WAN utilizing multiple point to point VPN connections. 

Led a small team of technical support staff to facilitate enterprise level availability of the corporate network and it's systems. 

Designed, developed, and coordinated numerous software projects ranging from customer market research analysis tools to the corporate presence on the Internet which included a streaming multimedia learning portal powered by a customized ecommerce implementation.

positions.title: Helpdesk / Programmer
positions.description:
Primarily responsible for help desk duties, assisting in general computer support for all corporate employees. 

Developed several internal applications used for data exports in support of various telecom industry regulations. 

Handled the development of the end user facing DSL availability checker for the in house Internet Service Provider.

volunteerExperiences.description: Designed, built, and maintained the church and food pantry websites, using web authoring tools and scripting languages, content creation tools, management tools, and created various digital media assets

• Directed live broadcasts, films and recordings, and created non-broadcast programming for public consumption
• Created graphics and media assets for live streaming broadcasts
• Designed and architected the live streaming system used for multiple weekly live broadcast streams
